name: AI Agent QA Harness: test cases, Claude grading, Slack scorecard

parameters.content:
## Start a QA run
`POST /webhook/agent-qa-run` with `Authorization: Bearer <QA_RUN_SECRET>`. The body can be `qa/test-cases.json` itself, plus options: `wait` (answer with the scorecard when done), `threshold`, `only` (case ids), `label`. Cases can also come from `QA_CASES_URL` and a Google Sheet. Every setting and case is checked before the first message is sent.

## One case at a time
The test message goes to `AGENT_URL` (timeouts, 5xx and bad JSON are a failed case, not a crash). Code checks the phrases, tool calls, fields and grader-aimed text. Claude grades the rubric with a strict forced tool call; the reply is escaped data inside tags, never instructions.

## Scorecard
Ready means every case was graded, the pass rate reaches the threshold and no critical case failed. The run is compared with the last saved run of the suite, posted to Slack, then saved as the next baseline. A run Claude could not fully grade, or whose scorecard Slack refused, is not saved and ends as failed.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Refused a QA run request: the Authorization: Bearer secret was missing or wrong.' + ($('Read Request').first().json.secretSet ? '' : ' QA_RUN_SECRET is empty, so every request is refused.') }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ started: true, runId: $('Load Cases').first().json.run.runId, suite: $('Load Cases').first().json.run.suite, cases: $('Load Cases').all().length }) }}
